_context: Owner LM-C (LAUNCH-MONITOR-SPEC 3.3, 3.6, 4.2). Lazy namespace. Text drawn on the charts and the canvas aria-labels (role=img). {unit} is an already translated unit, {side} an already translated direction (dir.*), {view} one of traj3d.view_*.
legend.estimated: Solid line with a light band: estimate and its ±1σ range
side.empty: Side view: no flight data to draw
side.one: Side view: carry about {carry} {unit}, apex about {apex} {unit} (estimated, with a ±1σ band)
side.one_low: Side view: carry about {carry} {unit}, apex about {apex} {unit} (low confidence, dashed)
side.many: Side view: {n} trajectories, carry {min} to {max} {unit}; {low} of them low confidence (dashed)
side.many_sampled: Side view: {shown} of {n} shots drawn (sampled), carry {min} to {max} {unit}; {low} of them low confidence (dashed)
top.empty: Top view: no landing points to draw
top.one: Top view: lands about {x} {unit}, {side}; the outline is the ±1σ range
top.one_unknown: Top view: lands about {x} {unit}; this camera angle cannot see left or right, so it sits on the centre line inside the “?” band
top.many: Top view: {n_plane} shots with left/right data on the plane, with a 1σ ellipse per club; {n_strip} shots with distance only in the strip below
top.many_sampled: Top view: {shown} of {n} shots drawn (sampled); {n_plane} with left/right data, {n_strip} distance only (strip below)
top.path: Top view: the flight path seen from above
tracer.alt: Ball tracer: {detected} detected points in the video (solid) and {simulated} simulated points (dotted)
tracer.none: Ball tracer: no ball positions to draw for this clip
traj3d.empty: 3D view: no flight data to draw
traj3d.alt: 3D view: {n} shots, {view}, turned {yaw} degrees; ground grid every 25 {unit}
traj3d.alt_sampled: 3D view: {shown} of {n} shots drawn (sampled), {view}, turned {yaw} degrees; ground grid every 25 {unit}
traj3d.to_top: Switch to the view from above
traj3d.hint: Drag with one finger to turn the view, or use the buttons below.
box.alt: Box plot: {groups} clubs, {n} shots in total, in {unit}; each box holds the middle half of the shots, the whiskers run from the 10th to the 90th percentile, the thick bar is the median
